preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p_list) and all(0 <= c_i <= n-1 for c_i in c_list)
preconditions.description: For each vertex i (1 ≤ i ≤ n), p_i is its parent (0 if root) and c_i is the count of vertices in its subtree with a_j < a_i, where 0 ≤ p_i ≤ n and 0 ≤ c_i ≤ n-1.

preconditions.expression: len(p_list) == n and len(c_list) == n and all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n+1))
preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly n vertices, each with a unique index from 1 to n, and their corresponding p_i and c_i values.
The parent pointers p_list form a valid rooted tree with n vertices (exactly one root, no cycles, and all vertices connected).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(a_list) == n and all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a_list))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output 'NO'. If a solution exists, output 'YES' followed by a list of n integers a_i (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9) representing the original values on the vertices.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(0 <= c_i <= subtree_size(i) - 1 for i in range(1, n+1)) and all(c_i == sum(1 for j in subtree(i) if a_list[j-1] < a_list[i-1]) for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For every vertex i, the computed c_i matches the count of vertices j in its subtree where a_j < a_i, where subtree(i) is the set of vertices in the subtree of i (including i itself).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' implies exists(a_list) such that all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a_list) and all(c_i == sum(1 for j in subtree(i) if a_list[j-1] < a_list[i-1]) for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, there exists at least one valid assignment of a_i values that satisfies all c_i constraints.
